paletteHint: Add a step to the canvas, then connect its ports to build your process.
readActionHint: Read the selected deal and make its fields available to later steps.
taskActionHint: Create a follow-up task and link it to an accessible deal.
conditionActionHint: Compare a value from an earlier step and follow the matching or non-matching branch.
connectHint: Connect an output to an input or drop it on a step. Use + to add a connected step.
connectionHelp: Choose the next node here, or draw a connection on the canvas.
reconnectHelp: Reconnect either endpoint on the canvas, or choose its source, output and destination below.
noVariables: Connect an earlier step to make its values available here.
nodeKeyboard: Press Enter to select a node. Use arrow keys to move it, or Delete to remove it.
edgeKeyboard: Press Enter to select a connection. Press Delete to remove it.
issueDisconnected: Connect this node to the manual start.
issueMapping: Choose a value from an earlier step connected on this path.
issueType: Choose a value of the matching type.
issueBranch: Connect both condition outcomes to their next steps.

connectionErrors.missingNode: That node is no longer available.
connectionErrors.cycle: This connection would create a loop. Connect to a later step instead.
connectionErrors.occupiedInput: This input already has a connection. Reconnect or remove it first.
connectionErrors.occupiedOutput: This output already has a connection. Reconnect or remove it first.
connectionErrors.invalidPort: Choose a valid output and an action node as the destination.
connectionErrors.nodeLimit: A workflow supports up to 100 steps.

delayLiteralRequired: Mapped durations are not available. Enter a fixed number of minutes.
delayMinutesHint: Elapsed whole minutes ({min} to {max}), not business or calendar days.
title: Workflows
subtitle: Turn a repeatable process into a clear, reliable workflow.
scope: Start manually, read a deal, branch on conditions, and create follow-up tasks. More actions are on the roadmap.
name: Workflow name
emptyHint: Start with a follow-up template, then make it yours.
pauseHint: Pausing prevents new runs. Existing runs, including waiting runs, can continue while the workflow is not archived and the person who started them still has permission to run it.
subject: Follow up with the customer
dealTitle: Deal title from the previous step
triggerHint: Choose a deal when you start a run. This workflow never runs automatically.
readHint: Reads the chosen deal using the permissions of the person starting the run.
taskHint: Creates an undated task, assigned to the person running this workflow and linked to the chosen deal.
configureHint: Choose a step to configure its details.
simulationHint: Simulation validates the published workflow without keeping task changes.
liveHint: This creates real tasks. Check the selected deal before starting.
publishedHint: Runs use the published version. Save and publish your changes to include them.
queuedHint: Queued for the background worker. Processing may take up to a minute.
historyHint: Simulate a published version before running it on customer data.
completedSteps: {count, plural, one {One step completed} other {# steps completed}}
loadError: The workflows could not be loaded.
denied: You do not have access to workflows. Ask an administrator to review your permissions.
error: The change could not be completed. Try again.
conflict: This workflow changed in another window. Your draft is still here. Reload after saving a copy of your changes.
invalid: Check the workflow configuration before publishing.
issues: {count, plural, one {One configuration issue to resolve} other {# configuration issues to resolve}}
issue: Check this step’s inputs and connections.
notReady: This workflow contains an action that is not available yet.
bindingMissing: A required value was not available. Check the step’s field mapping.
runError: This run stopped before completion. Review its configuration and permissions.
nodeDescription: Press Enter to select a step.
searchHint: Enter at least two characters to find a deal.
focusHint: Build your process on the canvas. Press Escape to return to the workflow.
createHint: Choose a starting point and give this workflow a name.
connectedPaletteHint: Choose the next step. It will be connected to the selected output automatically.
connectionBlocked: This connection is unavailable. Choose a free input.
drawingConnection: Choose an input, or release on empty canvas to add a step.
manualSummary: Choose a deal when starting a run.
historicalGraphHint: Inspect the published version used for this run.
traceHint: Green steps completed. Unmarked steps have not been reached. Select a step to find it on the graph.
simulationTraceHint: Simulation: no task changes were kept. Green steps show the path that was checked.
liveTraceHint: Live run: completed actions have been applied. This graph is read-only.
rewiringConnection: Choose a new input. Releasing on empty canvas keeps the original connection.
waitRecoveryHint: The run becomes eligible at this time. Background recovery is scheduled every minute; execution can start later. Cancellation stops this wait and later steps; completed actions remain.
leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved workflow changes. Leave without saving?
leavePending: A workflow change is still in progress. Leaving will not cancel it. Leave?
retryHint: Continue this run from the failed step. Completed tasks will not run again.
retryRequested: Retry requested. Current progress is shown above.
retryDenied: Your access changed. Refresh or sign in again before retrying.
retryConflict: This run changed. Refresh to see its current state before retrying.
retryUnavailable: This step cannot be retried yet. Refresh after resolving the reported issue.
retryUnknown: We could not confirm the retry. Refresh its status before trying again.
retryRecorded: Retry requested by the original runner:
retryLegacyFailure: Earlier failure snapshot, stored update time:

retryReason.legacy: This older failure has no reliable recovery record. Review completed work before starting another run.
retryReason.actor: Only the person who started this run can retry it.
retryReason.permission: Access changed. Restore the required access and refresh before retrying.
retryReason.paused: Re-enable this workflow before retrying its failed step.
retryReason.unsupported: This run cannot safely resume from this step. Review completed work before starting another run.
retryReason.repair: Resolve the reported issue, then refresh to check whether the step can be retried.
retryReason.inconsistent: The saved progress needs review before this run can be resumed.

libraryFilterHint: Search and filter the workflows you can view. Updates can move items between pages.
libraryNoMatchesHint: Try a different search or status, or clear the filters.
libraryOwnersError: Workflow owners could not be loaded.
libraryPageChangedHint: Updates or changed access can leave this page empty. Return to the first page with your filters.
libraryArchivedEmptyHint: Workflows you archive remain available here with their history.
libraryRunIdentity: Runs as: person starting the run
archiveHint: New runs are blocked. An incomplete run fails when it next advances and its waiting deadline is cleared. Completed work and history remain.
unarchiveHint: This workflow returns inactive. Publish explicitly before starting new runs.
duplicateHint: Copies the saved draft. Unsaved editor changes are not included.
restoreHint: Replaces only the draft. The active version and existing runs stay unchanged.
restoreUnsaved: Your unsaved changes will be replaced.
copyUnavailable: This saved draft includes configuration that cannot be copied safely. Review its steps before duplicating.
writeUnknown: We could not confirm this change. It may already have been saved. Review the current workflows before another attempt.
refreshAfterAck: The change was saved, but the current view could not be refreshed. Refresh to review its current state.
navigationAfterAck: The workflow was saved, but could not be opened. Open it again without repeating the change.
lifecycleInvalid: Check the workflow name and try again.
versionsHint: Review an earlier publication. Restoring replaces only the draft.
allowRetry: I reviewed the library; allow another attempt
retryReconcileHint: If the earlier copy exists, open it instead. Only retry after checking the library.
archivedHint: Archived workflows are read-only. New runs are blocked; existing runs stop when they next advance. Completed actions remain.
cancelUnknown: We could not confirm cancellation. Refresh and review this run before another attempt.
allowCancelRetry: I reviewed the run; allow another cancellation attempt
libraryInvalidFilters: Check the search and filters, then try again.
